card.summary: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month incl...

free_tier.stated: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month included. Unresolved; treat as small until an account test settles it.

retention.stated: Per-object-cap: entry upload bounded by the storage allowance; request-rate: API requests currently unlimited/free; per-ip-shaping: none documented. Retention: releases are immutable snapshots, kept until deleted. Good archive semantics if the quota is real.

egress.terms: Metered after a free tier allowance: 'Bandwidth (CCD) 50 GB / month. After 50 GB: $0.08 per GB, After 50 TB: $0.06 per GB'.

record.tooling: UGS CLI (`ugs ccd ...`), Content Delivery Management API and Client API, plus the CCD Management SDK. Releases are content-addressed: entries carry an md5 content hash and size that must match on upload.
record.chaining: Buckets per environment x releases per bucket x promotion between buckets. Note: 'Creating or promoting a new release does not create copies of the entries in a bucket'. Promotion is a pointer, not a copy, so it does NOT multiply storage.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: entry upload bounded by the storage allowance; request-rate: API requests currently unlimited/free; per-ip-shaping: none documented. Retention: releases are immutable snapshots, kept until deleted. Good archive semantics if the quota is real.
record.reliability_note: The old CCD API-key auth and UCD CLI were deprecated in 2024 with no planned sunset after community pushback, so the write path still works but is on a deprecated auth path. Public read URLs are of the form https://{projectId}.client-api.unity3dusercontent.com/client_api/v1/buckets/{bucketId}/releases/{releaseId}/entry_by_path/content/?path=<path>.

evidence.proved: Cloud Content Delivery: 'Cloud Storage — Free — Free'; 'Bandwidth (CCD) 50 GB / month; After 50 GB: $0.08 per GB'
'ストレージ容量 5 GB/月' (5 GB/month storage, ~$0.08/GB/mo overage) — direct contradiction of the 'Free' line
read URL format, md5+size content hash requirement, 'Creating or promoting a new release does not create copies of the entries in a bucket'
probe: GET -> 404 {"code":5,"details":["not found"],"reason":"Not found"} — API is live and gated on a project/org token

record.notes: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month included. Unresolved; treat as small until an account test settles it.

dead_end.why: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month included. Unresolved; treat as small until an account test settles it.
